topic: How this blog is researched, checked and published

sources.title: Confident errors
sources.markdown:
# Confident errors

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

Language models can produce fluent text that states incorrect facts with confidence, so their output needs checking against sources.

sources.title: Checking quotes
sources.markdown:
# Checking quotes

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

Comparing each quoted passage with the text of the page it came from caught most misattributed quotes in the test set.

sources.title: Sources and trust
sources.markdown:
# Sources and trust

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

Readers rated articles as more trustworthy when every factual claim linked to the source it came from.

# Editors and AI drafting
